intro: The Filled Red Waterskin contains pristine spring water drawn from the village well in Tarren Mill. Gathering this pure water amidst the blighted ruins held by the Forsaken serves as a vital trial for young shaman seeking communion with the water spirits.

p: While training shaman in the ways of water, the hermit Brine in the Barrens dispatches initiates on a lengthy journey to Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Amidst the decay and the dead, the town's central well miraculously draws clear, untainted spring water. Brine regards this holy vestige in an unhallowed land as an emblem of enduring spirit—drawing a parallel between the uncorrupted spring and Warchief Thrall's enduring resolve despite profound hardship. Gathering this sample proves an initiate's reverence for water's purity regardless of hostile surroundings.
